# Adway Insights

> A comprehensive resource hub for talent acquisition professionals featuring expert insights, webinars, and guides on modern recruitment strategies.

Adway Insights provides curated content on talent acquisition trends, employer branding, and recruitment best practices. The platform hosts webinars, thought leadership pieces, and resources from industry experts focused on helping organizations attract and retain top talent through data-driven and personalized approaches.

## Key Topics

- Talent Acquisition
- Employer Branding
- Recruitment Marketing
- Hyper-Personalization
- Social Recruitment
- Diversity & Inclusion
- Recruitment Trends
- Quality of Hire
- Hiring Best Practices
- Remote Work
- Video Interviewing
- Candidate Experience
- LinkedIn Recruiting
- Webinars
- Resource Library

## Featured Webinars & Events

- [Adway Live: Mega Trends In Talent Acquisition With Hung Lee](https://content.adway.ai/insights/adway-live-mega-trends-in-talent-acquisition-with-hung-lee): Webinar summary on mega trends in talent acquisition with industry expert Hung Lee
- [SIME 2024: Embracing Hyper-Personalisation in Recruitment](https://content.adway.ai/insights/sime-2024-embracing-hyper-personalisation-in-recruitment): SIME 2024 insights on hyper-personalization and candidate experience in modern hiring strategies

## Talent Acquisition Insights

- [Diversity & Inclusion: The Personal Journey](https://content.adway.ai/insights/diversity-inclusion-the-personal-journey): Personal insights on diversity and inclusion in talent acquisition strategy and organizational culture

- [Adway Insights - Resources for smarter talent attraction](https://content.adway.ai/): Central hub for talent acquisition resources including whitepapers, guides, webinars, and best practices
